classifier_features: Original audit features, shared by every model
classifier_settings: Logistic and histogram, five paired folds, no permutations
secondary_classifier: Histogram with genotype indicators added to audit features
loo_noise: Refit all pilot parameters without each calibration row. Estimate latent residual scale in the full pilot coordinate system.
raw_quadratic: Raw additive fitness plus four depth/additive features. Ridge penalty 10. Leave-one-out residual pair scale.
learned_pairs: Fit Bayesian ridge to pilot latent residuals after the reference mean. Sample shared pair coefficients from their posterior. No added observation noise.
spectra: Descriptive full-library binary projection. Includes calibration rows and prior evaluation genotypes.
limits: Exploratory within-protein study. Fresh genotype splits do not provide independent-protein confirmation.
